narrative.openingSituation: A pirate crew finds a beautiful youth and imagines ransom or sale.
narrative.centralConflict: Only the helmsman recognizes the danger of treating the stranger as ordinary prey.
narrative.resolution: Dionysus fills the ship with divine signs and transforms the attackers.
narrative.outcome: The helmsman survives, while the pirates live on as dolphins.
